input.headline: Repo funding spread spikes: GSD settlement liquidity under pressure
input.what_happened: The SOFR−EFFR repo funding spread rose to 8 basis points on Nov 3, its weekly peak.
input.so_what_front: Tighter repo funding can raise members' daily settlement costs, straining GSD settlement payments and liquidity.
input.so_now_what_front: Confirm GSD treasury operations have intraday liquidity resources ready for elevated settlement demands.
input.action_reason: S is at its highest level and V is elevated; confirming liquidity resources are ready is the priority before settlement stress materialises.
